nodes.name: Kristy Bourret
nodes.about: Kirsty Bourret is a Registered Midwife, health systems researcher, and Associate Researcher with the Health Systems and Equity program at NOSM University and the Thunder Bay Regional Health Research Institute. Her work focuses on reproductive justice, maternal-child health equity, and learning health systems in Northern and remote contexts. She is developing a program of research in Northern Ontario Reproductive Health Learning Health Systems (NOLHS) to advance equity-informed, systems-embedded approaches to care. Kirsty leads and collaborates on applied research with communities, health system actors, and policy leaders. She serves on the Global Programs Advisory Council at the Canadian Association of Midwives and chairs the Ontario Midwifery Research Group
